Facts: Zhang (villager) blocked construction, got into conflict. He called his son Li, Li slapped Wang. Then Wang instructed workers to beat Li, causing Li light injury (一级轻伤). That's intentional injury (故意伤害). Also Wang instructed others to make false testimony (伪证) i.e., perjury? The list includes "妨害作证" (obstructing testimony) or "妨害作证" is interfering with testimony. Also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" not relevant. "妨害作证" is likely the crime for making false statements to police. Also "指使他人实施故意伤害" maybe "故意伤害" covers both. Additionally, "指使" could be "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" not relevant. There's also "妨害公务" but that's interfering with officials. Here they made false statements to police, which is "妨害作证". Also "指使" could be "教唆犯罪"? Not in list. There's "妨害作证" is the appropriate.

Thus crimes: 故意伤害;妨害作证
